review_evidence: README states that LeanGeo is a manually formalized system of plane-geometry theorems and proofs in Lean 4 built on LeanEuclid.
The source reports 260 theorems organized into Basic, Metrics, Triangle, Circle, and Quadrilateral classes, with a separate 122-problem LeanGeo-Bench.
The repository therefore directly supplies geometry statements/proofs and formal SystemE-style interfaces; benchmark/example roles do not justify hard exclusion under FILTER-011.
summary: Retain LeanGeo: it is a substantial formal plane-geometry theorem library and benchmark built on an axiomatic Euclidean geometry framework.
